Grain
Le Mars Agri-Center offers years in grain knowledge and expertise. Whether you are buying or selling grain, we offer competitive prices. Innovative risk management products and marketplace leverage that will give you the edge you need to succeed for your farming operation. Farming does not come without risk, exactly the reason we want to be your partner in the business. We will help you identify price, evaluate political and currency risks and discuss the ever-changing weather. Talking through the options and finding the best path to maximize your profits is exactly what we want for our customers. Your success is our success.
Part of that success is delivering and dumping your grain in an efficient, pleasant atmosphere. Our employees have years of experience working at Le Mars Agri-Center and always have your best interest in mind and enjoy getting to know you and your operation.
